messages.author: d0ef5f4d577804c1
messages.subject: Non-standard mrsd dating
parts:
Hi All,
My mcc tree is scaled in days, how can I implement day msrd in ggtree?
here my attempt to do so that failed:

mcc <- read.beast(file = "126G_MCC.tree")
mcc

get.fields(mcc)

p <- ggtree(mcc, aes(color = location)) + scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange1", "cyan3")) +
  geom_point2(aes(label = round(posterior), subset = posterior >= 0.9), size = 1.5) +
  theme_tree2(legend.position = "right") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(20, 29))

p$data$mcc <- p$data$mcc - max(p$data$mcc) + 29
p + theme_tree2()

Can someone help me fix this?
Thanks!
Carla
